events.title: CelSector Launches Nov 12 + Steam Next Fest Demo & v1.2 Preview!
events.summary: Hey everyone! CelSector comes to Steam on November 12, and we're bringing a big launch update with it. Wishlist now so you don't miss it (and to catch the 10% launch-week discount). We're also in Steam Next Fest from October 19-26. For those of you who haven't tried it yet, the demo is ready to be downloaded - try it and tell us what you think on Discord.
